es: Interpretar gráficos de asistencia, pasos y temperaturas: reconocer verbos de tendencia, cifras aproximadas y proporciones.

teaching.en: As the chart shows, attendance rose steadily from 400 to 900 over the whole season, without a single sharp drop along the way.
teaching.es: Como muestra el gráfico, la asistencia subió de forma constante de 400 a 900 a lo largo de toda la temporada, sin una sola caída brusca en el camino.
teaching.explanationEs: As the chart shows abre la descripción; rose steadily dice que subió sin saltos; from… to… da el inicio y el final.
segments: As the chart shows, attendance rose steadily from 400 to 900 over
the whole season, without a single sharp drop along the way.
teaching.audioText: As the chart shows, attendance rose steadily from 400 to 900 over the whole season, without a single sharp drop along the way.

teaching.en: Daily steps rose sharply by 20 percent in June, and that month turned out to be the peak of the entire year.
teaching.es: Los pasos diarios subieron bruscamente un 20 % en junio, y ese mes resultó ser el punto máximo de todo el año.
teaching.explanationEs: By + cifra dice cuánto cambió (en español «en un 20 %»). Peak es el punto más alto de la línea.
segments: Daily steps rose sharply by 20 percent in June, and that
month turned out to be the peak of the entire year.
teaching.audioText: Daily steps rose sharply by 20 percent in June, and that month turned out to be the peak of the entire year.

teaching.en: Temperatures fluctuate between 12 and 18 degrees throughout the spring, so it would be misleading to claim that there is a clear trend.
teaching.es: Las temperaturas fluctúan entre 12 y 18 grados durante toda la primavera, así que sería engañoso afirmar que hay una tendencia clara.
teaching.explanationEs: Fluctuate describe una línea en zigzag; trend es la dirección general de la línea.
segments: Temperatures fluctuate between 12 and 18 degrees throughout the spring, so it
would be misleading to claim that there is a clear trend.
teaching.audioText: Temperatures fluctuate between 12 and 18 degrees throughout the spring, so it would be misleading to claim that there is a clear trend.

teaching.en: Roughly two thirds of the fans come by bus, which means that the majority of them travel together to every match.
teaching.es: Aproximadamente dos tercios de los aficionados vienen en autobús, lo que significa que la mayoría viaja junta a cada partido.
teaching.explanationEs: Roughly suaviza la cifra porque no es exacta. Majority significa más de la mitad, y dos tercios la superan.
segments: Roughly two thirds of the fans come by bus, which means
that the majority of them travel together to every match.
teaching.audioText: Roughly two thirds of the fans come by bus, which means that the majority of them travel together to every match.

teaching.en: Only a quarter of the students walk to school, and that proportion has stayed in the region of twenty-five percent during the last five years.
teaching.es: Solo una cuarta parte de los estudiantes va andando al colegio, y esa proporción se ha mantenido en torno al veinticinco por ciento durante los últimos cinco años.
teaching.explanationEs: A quarter es el 25 %. Proportion es la parte que algo representa dentro del total; in the region of significa «alrededor de».
segments: Only a quarter of the students walk to school, and that proportion has
stayed in the region of twenty-five percent during the last five years.
teaching.audioText: Only a quarter of the students walk to school, and that proportion has stayed in the region of twenty-five percent during the last five years.

teaching.en: After the summer surge, visitor numbers began to plateau, or level off, and the two busiest months account for nearly half of the yearly total.
teaching.es: Tras el aumento repentino del verano, el número de visitantes empezó a estabilizarse (plateau, o level off), y los dos meses más concurridos representan casi la mitad del total anual.
teaching.explanationEs: Surge es una subida repentina; plateau o level off, dejar de subir; account for + fracción dice qué parte del total representa algo.
segments: After the summer surge, visitor numbers began to plateau, or level off, and
the two busiest months account for nearly half of the yearly total.
teaching.audioText: After the summer surge, visitor numbers began to plateau, or level off, and the two busiest months account for nearly half of the yearly total.

prompt.es: Lee la nota del entrenador y elige qué línea describe la asistencia.

choices.text: It fell sharply after March and then recovered to its earlier peak.
It climbed without jumps, reached a peak and then went up and down.
It levelled off at nine hundred and stayed there until the end.

feedback.es: La nota dice que la asistencia subió de forma constante hasta marzo y luego fluctuó entre 600 y 700, sin una tendencia clara.

hint.es: Fíjate en qué hace la línea primero (steadily) y en qué hace después (fluctuate).

origin.text: Coach's note: 'Attendance rose steadily until March, when roughly 900 fans came to the match. After that, the numbers began to fluctuate between 600 and 700, so I cannot see a clear trend for the rest of the season.'

prompt.es: Completa: «La proporción de estudiantes que van en bici sigue siendo una cuarta parte.»

feedback.es: Proportion es la parte que algo representa dentro del total; aquí cambia el número de ciclistas, pero no su parte del total.

hint.es: Es la parte que algo representa dentro del total, no una cifra absoluta.

origin.text: Last year 240 of 960 students cycled to school, and this year 250 of 1,000 do. The ___ of students who cycle has hardly changed: it is still one quarter.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Los dos meses más concurridos representan casi la mitad del total anual.»

answer.text: The two busiest months account for nearly half of the yearly total

feedback.es: Account for + fracción dice qué parte del total representa algo; el sujeto plural (months) pide account, sin -s.

hint.es: Empieza por el sujeto: los dos meses más concurridos.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo evolucionó el número de visitantes del parque.

choices.text: A sudden jump in the spring followed by a slow and steady fall.
A steady rise that ended in July and was followed by a sharp drop.
A steady rise, a sudden jump in July and then a flatter line.

feedback.es: El audio habla de una subida constante en primavera, una surge en julio y después una estabilización (level off).

origin.audio: Here is what the chart tells us about the park. Visitor numbers climbed slowly but surely through the spring, and then there was a surge in July, when a big crowd came in a single week. Since then the line has stayed flat, and most of the visitors now arrive at the weekend.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase sobre el gráfico con su traducción natural.

pairs.es: Las ventas se dispararon en junio.

pairs: Prices levelled off in July.

pairs.es: Los precios se estabilizaron en julio.

pairs: Rent accounts for half of my costs.

pairs.es: El alquiler representa la mitad de mis gastos.

pairs: Numbers fluctuate all year.

pairs.es: Las cifras suben y bajan todo el año.

feedback.es: Cada expresión describe un movimiento distinto: subida repentina, estabilización, parte del total y zigzag.

pairs.es: Las ventas se dispararon en junio.

pairs: Prices levelled off in July.

prompt.es: Completa: «La asistencia subió de forma constante de 400 en enero a 900 en marzo.»

feedback.es: Rose steadily describe una subida constante, sin saltos ni caídas, como la de esta línea de enero a marzo.

origin.text: The report covers the whole season. Attendance rose ___ from 400 in January to 900 in March, with no sudden jumps and no falls along the way.

prompt.es: Escucha el informe del club y elige qué opina la tesorera sobre la bajada.

choices.text: That a few weeks of exams explain most of the fall in numbers.
That a quarter of the fans have stopped coming to the big matches.
That the falling line shows the club should play more matches.

feedback.es: La tesorera atribuye la mayor parte de la bajada a dos semanas de exámenes, es decir, a una causa temporal y no a un desinterés general.

origin.audio: In our club's yearly review, the chart is clear about one thing: attendance rose steadily for four months, peaked in March, and then began to rise and fall. Some members say the club is losing interest, but the treasurer is more cautious. She points out that most of the drop comes from two weeks of exams, when far fewer students could attend. A quarter of the fans, she adds, come only for the big matches, so a single figure can hide very different habits.

prompt.es: Con el mismo audio, elige qué da a entender la tesorera sobre las cifras.

choices.text: That the big matches are the only reason why the club still exists.
That one overall number can hide very different ways of attending.
That most fans would come more often if the tickets were cheaper.

feedback.es: Al decir que una sola cifra puede esconder hábitos muy distintos, la tesorera advierte contra sacar conclusiones de un único dato.

origin.audio: In our club's yearly review, the chart is clear about one thing: attendance rose steadily for four months, peaked in March, and then began to rise and fall. Some members say the club is losing interest, but the treasurer is more cautious. She points out that most of the drop comes from two weeks of exams, when far fewer students could attend. A quarter of the fans, she adds, come only for the big matches, so a single figure can hide very different habits.

prompt.es: Completa: «Este año las cifras fluctúan tanto que no hay tendencia clara.»

feedback.es: Fluctuate describe un zigzag que impide ver una tendencia; vary sería una alternativa igual de válida.

origin.text: Unlike last year, when the line rose steadily, this year's numbers ___ so much that nobody can identify a clear trend. The committee therefore prefers to wait for the next report.

prompt.es: Lee el aviso de la liga y elige qué da a entender el comité.

choices.text: That the drop is lasting, so the schedule must change now.
That exams are certainly the cause of the whole fall in numbers.
That the drop may be temporary, so no action is needed yet.

feedback.es: El comité condiciona cualquier cambio a que la bajada continúe en mayo: por ahora la considera posiblemente temporal.

origin.text: Note from the league office: 'Match attendance fell from 900 in March to 640 in April, but two of the April games were held on exam days. Unless the fall continues in May, the committee will not change the schedule.'

prompt.es: Lee el extracto del informe y elige qué actitud muestra ante la cifra de 9.000.

choices.text: Cautious: the headline figure hides a minority who walk much less.
Enthusiastic: every worker now walks more than before.
Disappointed: the figure proves that the company has failed.

feedback.es: El informe celebra el máximo de junio pero recuerda que una cuarta parte del personal anda poco: es una postura prudente, no triunfalista.

origin.text: Extract from the clinic's report: 'Daily steps among workers rose steadily to a peak of 9,000 in June. However, a quarter of the staff still recorded fewer than 4,000, so the overall figure should be read with care.'

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cuándo se concentró la mayoría de los días más calurosos.

choices.text: During the first half of spring.
In the second half of July.
Right at the start of the summer.

feedback.es: Dos tercios de los días más calurosos cayeron en las dos últimas semanas de julio, tras el máximo de 26 grados.

origin.audio: Temperatures fluctuated between twelve and eighteen degrees in spring, then rose sharply to peak at twenty-six in July. About two thirds of the hottest days fell in the last two weeks of that month.

prompt.es: Completa: «La encuesta cubrió 2.000 hogares y aproximadamente 1.200 notaron una subida.»

feedback.es: Roughly antes de una cifra indica que es aproximada; approximately, about o around funcionan igual.

origin.text: The survey covered 2,000 homes. ___ 1,200 of them reported a rise in their bills, while the others saw no change at all.

es: Proyectar tendencias con prudencia: is set to, is projected to, is expected to reach y by then, más la duración con will have been + -ing.

teaching.en: The number of members is set to reach 1,200 by 2030, as long as the current rise continues at the same pace.
teaching.es: El número de socios está previsto que llegue a 1.200 para 2030, siempre que la subida actual continúe al mismo ritmo.
teaching.explanationEs: Is set to + verbo base: los datos apuntan a que ocurrirá. By 2030 equivale a «para 2030».
segments: The number of members is set to reach 1,200 by 2030,
as long as the current rise continues at the same pace.
teaching.audioText: The number of members is set to reach 1,200 by 2030, as long as the current rise continues at the same pace.

teaching.en: Daily steps are projected to rise by 10 percent over the next decade, assuming that nothing major changes in people's habits.
teaching.es: Se proyecta que los pasos diarios suban un 10 % durante la próxima década, suponiendo que no cambie nada importante en los hábitos de la gente.
teaching.explanationEs: Is/are projected to + verbo base: proyección que sale de un cálculo; es lenguaje propio de informes.
segments: Daily steps are projected to rise by 10 percent over the
next decade, assuming that nothing major changes in people's habits.
teaching.audioText: Daily steps are projected to rise by 10 percent over the next decade, assuming that nothing major changes in people's habits.

teaching.en: The club is expected to reach fifty teams, but the forecast could change if the league loses its main funding.
teaching.es: Se espera que el club llegue a cincuenta equipos, pero la previsión podría cambiar si la liga pierde su financiación principal.
teaching.explanationEs: Is expected to + verbo base dice lo que se espera. «Could change» añade prudencia.
segments: The club is expected to reach fifty teams, but the
forecast could change if the league loses its main funding.
teaching.audioText: The club is expected to reach fifty teams, but the forecast could change if the league loses its main funding.

teaching.en: By 2030 the league will have been growing for ten years, so more growth is likely, although it may not follow the same trajectory.
teaching.es: Para 2030 la liga llevará diez años creciendo, así que es probable que siga creciendo, aunque quizá no con la misma trayectoria.
teaching.explanationEs: Will have been + -ing mide cuánto dura algo hasta un momento futuro. Likely = probable; trajectory es el camino que sigue una línea.
segments: By 2030 the league will have been growing for ten years, so
more growth is likely, although it may not follow the same trajectory.
teaching.audioText: By 2030 the league will have been growing for ten years, so more growth is likely, although it may not follow the same trajectory.

teaching.en: Current figures suggest that the trend will continue, but this is only a rough estimate, and it rests on one important assumption.
teaching.es: Las cifras actuales sugieren que la tendencia continuará, pero esto es solo una estimación aproximada, y se apoya en un supuesto importante.
teaching.explanationEs: Rough estimate avisa de que no es una certeza; assumption es la condición que se da por buena para que el cálculo funcione.
segments: Current figures suggest that the trend will continue, but this is
only a rough estimate, and it rests on one important assumption.
teaching.audioText: Current figures suggest that the trend will continue, but this is only a rough estimate, and it rests on one important assumption.

teaching.en: The club is on track to double its membership by 2030, yet its income may hold steady, so the forecast remains uncertain.
teaching.es: El club va camino de duplicar sus socios para 2030, pero sus ingresos podrían mantenerse estables, así que la previsión sigue siendo incierta.
teaching.explanationEs: On track to + verbo base: lleva un ritmo que permite llegar a la meta; hold steady = no cambiar.
segments: The club is on track to double its membership by 2030,
yet its income may hold steady, so the forecast remains uncertain.
teaching.audioText: The club is on track to double its membership by 2030, yet its income may hold steady, so the forecast remains uncertain.

prompt.es: Lee el dato del club y elige la proyección que respeta el cálculo.

choices.text: The club will certainly have 1,000 members by 2030, whatever else happens.
The club is projected to reach about 1,300 members by 2030, if the pace holds.
The club is projected to reach about 1,000 members by 2030, if the pace holds.

feedback.es: Con 700 socios y unos 60 más al año, cinco años dan 1.000; la frase correcta calcula esa cifra y la presenta como proyección, no como promesa.

hint.es: Suma al dato actual el ritmo anual por los cinco años que faltan, y descarta lo que suena a promesa.

origin.text: Membership grew by about 60 people a year between 2020 and 2025, from 400 to 700. The treasurer's model assumes the same pace, so that pace is the only thing behind the figure for 2030.

prompt.es: Completa: «Para 2030, la liga llevará creciendo una década entera.»

feedback.es: Will have been + -ing expresa cuánto tiempo llevará algo ocurriendo en un momento futuro (2030).

hint.es: Es el participio de be que va entre will have y el verbo en -ing.

origin.text: The league started in 2020 with only eight teams. By 2030 it will have ___ growing for a whole decade, so a bigger calendar seems likely.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Se proyecta que los pasos diarios suban un 10 % en la próxima década.»

answer.text: Daily steps are projected to rise by 10 percent over the next decade

feedback.es: Are projected to + verbo base presenta la subida como resultado de un cálculo; by 10 percent da la cantidad del cambio.

hint.es: Empieza por el sujeto y sigue con are projected to.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige de qué depende la cifra de 600 socios.

choices.text: Of the pool staying open and the fees not changing.
Of the club finding more coaches and opening a second pool.
Of the league keeping the same number of teams until 2030.

feedback.es: La tesorera condiciona la cifra a dos supuestos: que la piscina siga abierta y que las cuotas no cambien.

origin.audio: Here is the treasurer's forecast. The club is set to reach six hundred members by 2030, but she was careful to add that this is only a rough estimate. It rests on one assumption: that the new pool stays open and that the fees stay the same. If either of those changes, she said, the figure is likely to be lower.

pairs.es: Está previsto que la cuota suba en mayo.

pairs: Sales are projected to fall by 4 percent.

pairs.es: Se proyecta que las ventas bajen un 4 %.

pairs.es: El club va camino de ganar la liga.

pairs: Prices should hold steady this year.

pairs.es: Los precios deberían mantenerse estables este año.

feedback.es: Cada estructura marca una fuerza distinta: previsión fija, cálculo, ritmo hacia una meta y estabilidad.

prompt.es: Lee los datos de natación y elige la proyección más prudente.

choices.text: Membership will reach 200 by 2030 because the trend is certain to continue until then.
Membership is projected to reach roughly 200 by 2030, although this is only an estimate.
Membership is expected to be 200 in 2025, and it will keep growing until 2030 at least.

feedback.es: Con 160 socios en 2025 y un ritmo de 8 al año, unos 200 en 2030 es una proyección razonable, presentada como estimación.

origin.text: Data from the swimming club: there were 120 members in 2020 and 160 in 2025. The rise has been steady, about eight new members every year, with no sign of a sudden change.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué actitud muestra la alcaldesa ante las cifras.

choices.text: Doubtful, because she thinks the report used the wrong figures.
Alarmed, because the town is about to lose its health centre.
Confident, but warning that the figures depend on one condition.

feedback.es: La alcaldesa ve probable la necesidad de un segundo centro, pero advierte de que el cálculo depende de una condición y pide no tomar las cifras como promesas.

origin.audio: The local council has published its forecasts for the next decade. According to the report, the population of the town is projected to reach thirty thousand by 2035, and the number of children in school is expected to fall as the town grows older. The mayor said the town is on track to need a second health centre, but she added a warning: the forecast depends on one condition, that young families keep moving away. If that changes, the picture could look quite different. Residents were told not to take the figures as promises.

prompt.es: Con el mismo audio, elige qué cambiaría el panorama que presenta el informe.

choices.text: That young families stopped leaving the town.
That the council failed to build the second health centre.
That more children joined the school.

feedback.es: Si las familias jóvenes dejaran de marcharse, la condición del cálculo dejaría de cumplirse y el panorama cambiaría.

origin.audio: The local council has published its forecasts for the next decade. According to the report, the population of the town is projected to reach thirty thousand by 2035, and the number of children in school is expected to fall as the town grows older. The mayor said the town is on track to need a second health centre, but she added a warning: the forecast depends on one condition, that young families keep moving away. If that changes, the picture could look quite different. Residents were told not to take the figures as promises.

prompt.es: Completa: «La previsión es tan fiable como su suposición de que la tendencia no cambiará.»

feedback.es: Assumption es la suposición de partida de un cálculo; si falla, la previsión deja de servir.

origin.text: Every forecast is only as reliable as its ___ that the current trend will not change. If that fails, even a careful estimate will give the wrong figure.

prompt.es: Escribe una sola frase de proyección con are projected to, el plazo y una cautela.

answer.text: Daily steps are projected to rise to 8,000 by 2030, although this is only a rough estimate based on current habits.
accepted: Daily steps are projected to rise to 8,000 by 2030, although this is only a rough estimate based on current habits.
By 2030, daily steps are projected to reach 8,000, but this is only an estimate that could change.
Daily steps are projected to grow to 8,000 by 2030, assuming that people's habits do not change.

feedback.es: La frase lleva are projected to + verbo base, el plazo by 2030, la cifra y una cautela (only an estimate, could change o assuming that).

origin.text: Dato: hoy se dan 7.000 pasos diarios y el cálculo indica 8.000 en 2030 si los hábitos no cambian. Escribe una frase con are projected to, el plazo y una cautela.

prompt.es: Lee el extracto y elige qué quiere dar a entender el autor con su admisión.

choices.text: That the stadium will open late, so the club will lose many fans.
That the projected doubling is less certain than it first appears.
That the forecasts are wrong and have to be done again.

feedback.es: Al admitir que solo hay tres años de datos y que se supone que el estadio abrirá a tiempo, el autor relativiza el doble de asistencia previsto.

origin.text: The report's forecasts look convincing at first: attendance is expected to double by 2030. However, the authors admit that their forecast uses only three years of data, and that it supposes that the new stadium will open on time.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué se espera para las ventas del año que viene.

choices.text: A rise in sales, since the bigger shop will have closed by then.
No change at all, because this year's forecast was confirmed.
A fall in sales, since a bigger shop will be open by then.

feedback.es: El audio dice que para entonces la nueva tienda llevará dos años abierta, por lo que las ventas probablemente bajarán.

origin.audio: Our sales are projected to hold steady this year, but the forecast for next year is much less clear. By then, the new supermarket across the street will have been open for two years, so our figures are likely to fall.

prompt.es: Completa: «Se proyecta que la población de la ciudad se duplique en la próxima década.»

feedback.es: Decade es un periodo de diez años; over the next decade sitúa la proyección dentro de ese plazo.

origin.text: Experts disagree about the long run. Even so, the town's population is projected to double over the next ___, reaching sixty thousand by the mid-2030s.

es: Comprobar si una afirmación está respaldada, exagerada o sin evidencia, y distinguir una correlación de una causa.

teaching.en: The claim that sleep improves grades is supported by hard evidence from two schools, so it is safe to repeat it in the report.
teaching.es: La afirmación de que dormir mejora las notas está respaldada por pruebas sólidas de dos colegios, así que es seguro repetirla en el informe.
teaching.explanationEs: Supported by hard evidence: los datos dicen lo mismo que la afirmación, ni más ni menos. Hard evidence son pruebas comprobables.
segments: The claim that sleep improves grades is supported by hard evidence from
two schools, so it is safe to repeat it in the report.
teaching.audioText: The claim that sleep improves grades is supported by hard evidence from two schools, so it is safe to repeat it in the report.

teaching.en: Saying that every student improved is exaggerated: the data show gains for only seven out of ten, so the headline tends to overstate the result.
teaching.es: Decir que todos los estudiantes mejoraron es exagerado: los datos muestran mejoras solo en siete de cada diez, así que el titular tiende a exagerar el resultado.
teaching.explanationEs: Exaggerated: hay datos, pero la frase dice más (every, always, all). Overstate es el verbo: presentar algo como mayor de lo que es.
segments: Saying that every student improved is exaggerated: the data show gains for only
seven out of ten, so the headline tends to overstate the result.
teaching.audioText: Saying that every student improved is exaggerated: the data show gains for only seven out of ten, so the headline tends to overstate the result.

teaching.en: Sports injuries and temperatures rise together in summer, but that is only a correlation, and it does not mean that heat is the cause.
teaching.es: Las lesiones deportivas y las temperaturas suben juntas en verano, pero eso es solo una correlación y no significa que el calor sea la causa.
teaching.explanationEs: Dos cosas que suben a la vez tienen correlación; eso no prueba que una sea la cause de la otra.
segments: Sports injuries and temperatures rise together in summer, but that is only
a correlation, and it does not mean that heat is the cause.
teaching.audioText: Sports injuries and temperatures rise together in summer, but that is only a correlation, and it does not mean that heat is the cause.

teaching.en: Unlike last year, when attendance fell in every month, this year it rose, so the old explanation no longer seems to hold up.
teaching.es: A diferencia del año pasado, cuando la asistencia bajó todos los meses, este año subió, así que la vieja explicación ya no parece resistir.
teaching.explanationEs: Unlike + sustantivo o expresión de tiempo contrasta dos situaciones; hold up dice que una explicación sigue siendo válida ante los datos.
segments: Unlike last year, when attendance fell in every month, this year it
rose, so the old explanation no longer seems to hold up.
teaching.audioText: Unlike last year, when attendance fell in every month, this year it rose, so the old explanation no longer seems to hold up.

teaching.en: Girls' teams grew by 12 percent, whereas boys' teams grew by only 3 percent, so the two groups should not be described in the same way.
teaching.es: Los equipos de chicas crecieron un 12 %, mientras que los de chicos crecieron solo un 3 %, así que no deberían describirse de la misma manera.
teaching.explanationEs: Whereas une dos cláusulas completas que se contrastan; se puede usar while en su lugar.
segments: Girls' teams grew by 12 percent, whereas boys' teams grew by only 3
percent, so the two groups should not be described in the same way.

prompt.es: Escribe el informe: tendencia, comparación, interpretación prudente y proyección.

answer.text: Overall, the number of students who play tennis rose steadily from 35 in 2022 to 71 in 2025, so it has roughly doubled in three years. Compared with tennis, football hardly changed: around 80 students took part every year. Meanwhile, the difference between the two sports has narrowed from 45 students to only 12, although football remains the more popular sport. The biggest jump came in 2024, when 14 more students joined. This appears to be partly linked to the new indoor court, although the figures do not prove it. By contrast, the school budget stayed the same, which suggests that other reasons also matter. If this trend continues, tennis is likely to overtake football by 2026; consequently, the school may need extra coaches. Of course, this is only an estimate.

With doubt: she says that nobody can know if the court mattered.
With caution: she sees a link but refuses to claim a cause.

feedback.es: Mia reconoce que los datos sugieren un vínculo, pero no la llama causa porque el aumento empezó antes de que abriera la pista.

origin.audio: At the end of her talk on the school league, Mia took two questions. A teacher asked whether the league would keep growing, and Mia thanked him for a fair question. She explained that, if the trend continues, the league is likely to reach thirty teams by 2027, but she stressed that this is only an estimate. A parent then asked whether the new court had caused the rise. Mia said that the data suggest a link, but she could not call it the cause, because the increase began before the court opened. Finally, she admitted one limitation: the data cover only four years.

prompt.es: Con el mismo audio, elige por qué Mia menciona al final la limitación de los datos.

choices.text: To be honest about how far her conclusions can go.
To apologise for having chosen the wrong kind of chart.
To avoid having to answer any more questions.

feedback.es: Admitir que los datos cubren solo cuatro años es una muestra de honestidad sobre el alcance de sus conclusiones.

answer.text: Good morning, everyone. I will briefly walk through the results of our school league, and then I will open the floor to questions. On this slide, the line illustrates the trend: the number of teams rose steadily from 12 in 2022 to 24 in 2025, so it doubled in three years. I'd like to highlight the jump between 2024 and 2025, when six new teams joined. Someone asked whether the league will keep growing. That is a fair question. If the trend continues, it is likely to reach thirty teams by 2027, but this is only an estimate. Another question was whether the new court caused the rise. The data suggest a link, but I can't say it is the cause, because the increase started earlier. One limitation is that we only have four years of data. Thank you for listening.

origin.text: Gráfico de la liga escolar. Equipos inscritos: 2022: 12, 2023: 15, 2024: 18, 2025: 24. La cancha nueva se estrenó en 2024. Preguntas del público: 1) «¿Seguirá creciendo la liga?» 2) «¿La cancha nueva es la causa del aumento?» Escribe unas 120 a 220 palabras: saluda y anuncia, describe la tendencia con cifras, responde a las dos preguntas con cautela y menciona una limitación.

prompt.es: Lee el correo de la profesora y elige qué crítica hace a la presentación.

choices.text: That the slides were too clear for the audience to follow them.
That the presenter sounded more certain than the evidence allowed.
That the presenter talked for too long before taking questions.

feedback.es: La profesora alaba las diapositivas y critica la seguridad del presentador respecto a un efecto que solo dos temporadas no pueden probar.

origin.text: Teacher's email: 'Thanks for your presentation. I liked the clear slides, but I was concerned that you seemed very sure about the effect of the new coach when you only had two seasons of data. Next time, say what the figures cannot show.'

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué aconseja la colega si alguien cuestiona la proyección.

choices.text: Agree that the projection is wrong and remove the whole slide from the talk.
Promise that the league will double again in the next three years.
Explain that it is only an estimate and what it is based on.

feedback.es: Su consejo es ser honesto: presentar la proyección como estimación y explicar en qué se basa.

Then use one slide for each idea, and leave the limitation for last. If someone challenges the projection, just say that it is only an estimate, and explain what it is based on.
